expected_response.note: Incumbent preserved; no registered bounded edit has a defensible expected advantage under the affinity-primary objective.

failure_modes: Editing pointcloud_delta_A without an observable-level basis would change the robust curvature of the Hungarian endpoint distance while the cited pair-kernel and shape contrasts remain outside the executing scalar, risking unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates with no expected affinity gain.

Selecting a single region_index from sign-mixed landmark softmin and occupancy contrasts could over-concentrate attention at one landmark and displace coordinates elsewhere, since occupancy is a radial shell density rather than an atom count and signs are landmark-specific.
Changing teacher_neighbors treats a count as a distance bandwidth; the supplied teacher provenance provides no evidence that 2 or 8 neighbors improve mode coverage over the incumbent 4.

A temporal_teacher_blend or temporal_region_index edit would rely on time-conditioned structure that the supplied evidence does not validate: observed-node linear interpolation only within [0.0,0.49], no extrapolation, rejected Legendre runtime use, and multiple sign changes in first-to-last rates.

Reading joint internal/innovation RMS or turnover residuals as coordinate forces would misattribute diagnostic accounting quantities to the executing pointcloud reward, which contains no joint-motion or turnover term.
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The registered operative edit surface is narrow: pointcloud_delta_A (curvature of the executing pointcloud scalar), region_index (landmark attention), teacher_neighbors (count), temporal_region_index and temporal_teacher_blend. The Analyst's most reproducible signed contrasts are on pair_kernel_1.5-5.0 (endpoint_effects:9-12, q 1.5e-4 to 3.7e-3, positive batch fraction 0.857-1.0) with pair_kernel_7.0 opposing (endpoint_effects:13), and on shape_yy/shape_xx (endpoint_effects:4, 3). Per the formula_registry diagnostic_limit, the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term, so no permitted parameter maps onto those observables; changing pointcloud_delta_A would alter the robust curvature of the Hungarian endpoint distance without any supplied evidence that the 0.5/1.0/2.0 alternatives improve the affinity-primary objective. The landmark softmin contrasts (endpoint_effects:14, 32, 68) are landmark-specific and sign-mixed, and the occupancy signs are mixed across landmarks, so no single region_index is defensibly favored over the incumbent's uniform background attention. Teacher-neighbor count is a count, not a bandwidth, and the supplied teacher provenance (teacher_modes, static.json.gz, temperature_edits false) gives no evidence that 2 or 8 neighbors dominate the incumbent 4. Temporal alternatives are not supported: the continuous functions are observed-node linear interpolations over [0.0,0.49] with extrapolation_allowed false, the curve-fidelity audit rejects Legendre runtime use, and many features show large first-to-last rate z with multiple sign changes (continuous:1, continuous:7), so a time-conditioned teacher blend or temporal region index would not rest on a validated temporal contrast. Joint internal/innovation RMS effects (branch_adjusted:74, 76, 151, 153, 228, 230, 305, 307) are the most reproducible branch-adjusted signals but are diagnostics of joint pose/shape, not coordinate gradients, and the executing scalar has no joint-motion term. Turnover residuals (turnover:14, 17, 47, 134, 224, 227, 254, 257, 377, 497, 524, 584, 587) are accounting diagnostics including score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not causal selection effects. Decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable, so recorded joint-head credit cannot be read as final affinity benefit, and the information audit describes teacher score correlations as observational rather than a validated affinity predictor. Temperatures are immutable fixed parameters (mixture_temperature 0.5, teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2 4.0) and no temperature edit is admissible. With no defensible expected advantage for any registered bounded edit under the affinity-first objective, retaining the incumbent is the supported choice; the decision would change if a reproducible signed contrast existed on an observable the executing pointcloud scalar actually contains, or if a permitted parameter had supplied evidence of a directional affinity benefit.
